blocks.title: Runtime requirements
blocks.content: Visual verification depends on Poppler (pdftoppm). Without it the skill falls back to text-layer checks or asks you to review the output locally.

## When to use

PDF work where layout and visuals matter: generating formatted documents, reviewing existing PDFs, and confirming the final rendering before delivery.
